relation_vocabulary.fits: Direct physical/functional compatibility, only with exact evidence.
relation_vocabulary.needs: A product requires another component or condition to function as intended.
relation_vocabulary.avoids: A product or configuration should not be paired under an evidenced condition.
relation_vocabulary.requires: A mandatory technical prerequisite such as pressure, filtration, thread, or size.
relation_vocabulary.explicitReference: A first-party product page explicitly links another product; reference does not itself prove compatibility.
relation_vocabulary.merchandisingHint: Woo cross-sell/up-sell relation; candidate only, never treated as compatibility.
relation_vocabulary.sameSizeCandidate: Legacy same-size relation retained only for manual review.

policy.reference_rule: Internal links and Woo cross-sells are references/candidates, not technical compatibility claims.
policy.unknown_rule: Unknown remains unknown; no inherited specs from similar products.
